sections.title: Letter name and sound
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (jé) /jɛ/. It makes the sound in (jó) /ˈjoː/, which means good. This letter has only one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Lift the middle of your tongue near the roof of your mouth. Keep the air flowing smoothly. Turn your voice on. Touch your throat with your hand to feel the vibration.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of (jó) /ˈjoː/. You also hear it in the middle of (hajas) /ˈhɒjɒʃ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say the sound like the first letter in jam. Keep your tongue from touching the roof of your mouth. Say it like the first sound in yes.
